jobs.title: Senior AI & LLM Systems Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a Senior AI Systems Engineer to architect and productionize generative AI pipelines, vector retrieval architectures, and real-time LLM inference services.
responsibilities: Design low-latency generative AI model inference and agent orchestration workflows.
Optimize vector embedding pipelines and semantic retrieval indices using PostgreSQL and vector databases.
Implement continuous evaluations, fairness audits, and automated regression test benches for AI responses.
Collaborate directly with product design and frontend teams on conversational UI and streaming text-to-speech features.
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or related STEM field
certifications: GCP Professional Cloud Architect or AWS Machine Learning (Preferred)

jobs.title: Staff Full-Stack React & Node Engineer
jobs.description: Drive architecture across our high-scale enterprise SaaS application. You will build responsive React 19 frontends with Tailwind and high-throughput Node.js/TypeScript backend services.
responsibilities: Architect robust full-stack features with end-to-end type safety.
Design performant relational data models and maintain low-latency database queries.
Champion accessible, high-performance web applications and responsive design systems.
Mentor mid-level engineers and conduct thorough code reviews.
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer (Design Systems)
jobs.description: We are looking for a Lead Product Designer to evolve our global design system, design complex data workflows, and deliver intuitive enterprise recruitment tools.
responsibilities: Craft intuitive user experiences for data-dense enterprise dashboards.
Maintain and evolve our multi-brand design tokens and component library in Figma.
Conduct usability studies with recruiters and talent leaders.
Partner closely with frontend engineering to ensure pixel-perfect fidelity.
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's Degree in Interaction Design, HCI, or related field

jobs.title: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Maintain Kubernetes infrastructure, zero-downtime deployment pipelines, and observability suites across multi-region cloud clusters.
responsibilities: Manage production Kubernetes clusters on GCP and AWS.
Automate Terraform infrastructure-as-code and GitOps pipelines.
Configure Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog monitoring and alerting.

jobs.title: Principal Generative AI Architect
jobs.description: Lead generative AI agent development, vector embeddings, and real-time inference microservices.
responsibilities: Design and maintain production services with high performance and security.
Collaborate with product, UX, and fellow engineers on user features.
jobs.educationLevel: Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related STEM field
